attempts.summary: Configured a 3-node MariaDB 10.11.19 Galera cluster (galera-4 provider) across node1/node2/node3 on RHEL 7.9. Deployed galera.cnf with wsrep_cluster_address=gcomm://node1,node2,node3 and mariabackup SST; bootstrapped node1, joined node2/node3 via SST, all reached Synced/Primary state. Verified multi-master write propagation across all three nodes, demonstrated availability during a one-node outage (quorum preserved on 2/3), and confirmed automatic IST resync when the stopped node rejoined. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured boot_id + cluster health baseline on each node, restarted node1, node2, and node3 sequentially via systemctl reboot, confirmed each boot_id changed, and verified MariaDB auto-started and each node rejoined the cluster as Synced/Primary with all data intact after every restart.
